mapper.select: SELECT o.id,o.user_id,o.book_id,o.buy_num,o.total_money,o.create_time,b.book_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN book b ON o.book_id = b.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment c WHERE c.order_id = o.id) ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
